motivation: The high-turnover overnight tests are weak after costs, and index trend variants do not meet the combined return/drawdown goals. Test company-specific information diffusion on a days-to-weeks horizon, where potential moves are large relative to spread costs. This is a new hypothesis, not an optimized repair to an earlier rule.
universe: Same 37 stocks from groups.json, kept fixed to avoid adding recent winners. This is still a surviving-current-universe design and cannot establish broad market alpha. Include a monthly equal-weight buy-and-hold comparator on the same stocks as well as SPY and QQQ.
data: Public daily bars from 2010 through September 2026; analysis 2011-2025. Prior 20-session warmup and prices adjusted for corporate actions for signal returns. Actual historical nominal prices for whole shares and dollar P&L. Skip events with a stock split in preceding 20 sessions, including event day, to avoid volume normalization artifacts.
signal: At completed daily close: stock total return minus SPY total return >= max(0.03, 1.5 times lagged 20-session standard deviation of that residual); volume >=2 times lagged 20-session average; close is within top 25% of daily high-low range; nominal price>=5; nominal prior 20-session mean dollar volume >=20 million. No earnings-calendar or AI sentiment signal is assumed.
entry: Buy next regular-session open only if above event low minus $0.01. One open position per stock and per original peer group, at most four positions total. Rank simultaneous signals by residual divided by its lagged volatility, then ticker. No re-entry or adding while the group has an open trade.
exit: Two declared variants: exit at open after five full trading sessions, or after 20 full trading sessions. Stop at event-day low minus $0.01. If a later bar opens through the stop, use that worse open. Entry occurs at a bar open, so stop intrabar sequence is not ambiguous; no profit target. At end of evaluation mark remaining positions to close and deduct exit costs.
sizing: $2,500 initial cash, whole shares, 25% notional cap and 0.5% planned equity risk per position including costs. At most 100% cash notional, no borrowing. Signals allocate using contemporaneous equity at open, including existing marked positions. Fractional theoretical passive benchmarks reported separately. Stop losses are intended risk, not guaranteed gap limits.
costs: 5 and 10 bps round trip, half charged on each actual side; 20 bps stress. Report every declared holding horizon and cost, including inactive days. Dividend receivables credited on ex-date as an approximation, identified in limitations.
periods: 2011-2021 diagnostics and 2022-2025 reserved evaluation, with unchanged parameters. Also full 2011-2025 series. Annual, cash usage, concentration and drawdown results. No threshold changes after viewing outcomes.
decision: Require useful net reserved return relative to passive alternatives and <=25% observed EOD drawdown, then examine confidence and data/execution defects. Historical success alone is not a guarantee. If it fails, record failure rather than iteratively tune it into apparent success.
